name: monster.multimedia/multimedia-monster
title: Multimedia Monster
description: Discover Multimedia Monster's social account services, network requirements and request a quote.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: What Multimedia Monster does (sets up or repairs a brand's social accounts, connects them, posts across many networks with a visual check before every post), the networks with their live or planned status, what a brand provides, the onboarding steps, pricing (by quote, no published price) and how to start.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: The 16 networks in Multimedia Monster's scope. Each has a status (live: real posts sent from Multimedia Monster's server; planned: not posting yet) and its routes (official_api, webhook or browser) with how far each is built. Optional filters: status, route.

route.description: Only networks with a route of this kind.

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: For one network (or all): the account type the network requires, how the brand grants Multimedia Monster access, the minimum role Multimedia Monster accepts and what it never accepts, and whether the network verifies the business; plus the requirements common to every network and the acts only the brand's own person can do.

network.description: A network code from list_networks; omit for all.

tools.name: get_onboarding_steps
tools.description: How a brand is onboarded, step by step: what the brand receives, what the brand does and what Multimedia Monster does at each stage, what the brand provides, and how to start.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Records a quote request for Multimedia Monster; it answers at the contact email. Returns a request id only: no price is returned (pricing is by quote, set by Multimedia Monster). Required: company, contact_email. Optional: contact_name, website, networks (codes from list_networks), services, message, requested_by (the agent's name when asking for a company).

company.description: The brand or company the quote is for.

contact_email.description: Where Multimedia Monster sends the quote.

services.description: What the brand needs: setup of new accounts, repair of existing ones, connection, posting.

message.description: Anything else: volume, timing, accounts that exist today.

requested_by.description: If an agent is asking on a company's behalf: the agent or app's name.
